openapiEvidence: api/recovery-api-v4.yaml is not edited: GET /admin/parameters, its four query parameters and the Parameter schema already exist. No frontend/src/api/schema.d.ts regeneration. The three reference-load operations are exposed by RWB-E1-043 (D-RUN-10), not here.

capability.enforcement: @PreAuthorize("@capabilityCheck.require(authentication, 'Rules and parameters', 'R', 'read parameters')") through access.api.CapabilityCheck; the interim implementation is access.internal.InterimCapabilityCheck (bean name capabilityCheck)

queryParameters.name: environment
queryParameters.meaning: DEV, SIT, UAT or PROD; defaults to rwb.environment

rules: For a secret key, valueInForce, default, versionNo and validFrom are absent; owner, environments and usedBy are present (SPEC-010).
For a PRODUCT key, valueInForce, versionNo and validFrom are absent (SPEC-007, §7.5).
For an ENV key, valueInForce is present only when the requested environment is the running one, else absent (SPEC-007, SPEC-024).
No author or approver user ID is returned (SPEC-027).
usedBy is the used_by entries split on ';' and trimmed (§7.1).

errors.source: E7: DataAccessResourceFailureException or CannotCreateTransactionException caught in the controller
errors.body: status-only Problem: type urn:rwb:problem:unavailable, title, status, traceId; no messageCode, no detail

internalContracts.reasonInP4: P4 renders the Problem and P4 may not depend on P3 (SU-08 (d), D-RCV-11)

methods: boolean has(Authentication authentication, String area, String right)
boolean require(Authentication authentication, String area, String right, String action)
internalContracts.contract: require returns true, or throws ApiProblemException(ApiError.NOT_PERMITTED, Map.of("action", action), null); has has no side effect and never throws
internalContracts.replacementOwner: RWB-E1-037, which keeps the bean name

methods: <T> Value<T> get(String key, Class<T> type, LocalDate businessDate)
internalContracts.nested: record Value<T>(String key, T value, int versionNo, LocalDate validFrom, String environment)
internalContracts.contract: The only read path for code outside P3 (D-RUN-19). JDK exceptions only: IllegalArgumentException for an unknown key, a wrong type or a PRODUCT key; IllegalStateException for a secret; NoSuchElementException when nothing is in force and there is no default. The message holds the key only. No P1, P2 or P4 to P3 edge.

internalContracts.constructor: ApiProblemException(HttpStatus status, String messageId, Map<String,String> placeholders, String field, String detail, Throwable cause)
internalContracts.contract: error() returns null for this form; the ApiError constructor is unchanged. Guards: status required; messageId may be null only with 503, and then placeholders must be empty and field and detail null; otherwise IllegalArgumentException. detail is optional and, when set, replaces the resolver's EN text in the Problem.
callersOfError: access.internal.ApiExceptionHandler.problem (two call sites, both guarded by a null check after TASK-11)

methods: <T> ParameterValue<T> get(ParameterKey<T> key, String productGroup, LocalDate businessDate)
internalContracts.record: ParameterValue<T>(String key, T value, int versionNo, LocalDate validFrom, String environment)

members: public static final ParameterKey<T> <CONSTANT> per catalog row
public static <T> Optional<ParameterKey<T>> byName(String key, Class<T> type)
internalContracts.contract: byName returns empty when the key is absent or its type differs. The generated keys are the only catalog metadata any Java code reads; parameter_catalog is the persisted mirror.

methods: ParameterLoadResult load(InputStream csv, LocalDate validFrom, UUID authorUserId)
ParameterLoadResult rollback(UUID loadId, String reason, UUID userId)
internalContracts.record: ParameterLoadResult(UUID loadId, String table, LocalDate validFrom, String status, int rows, boolean repeat)
internalContracts.contract: Refusals are access.api.ApiProblemException with the message ID, status, placeholders and field of spec §10.2, so the caller's controller renders them unchanged. Unknown loadId: 404 MSG-P4-003 from approve and rollback; find returns Optional.empty(). Each method runs in its own REQUIRES_NEW transaction and does not join a caller's. This story builds no controller for these operations (D-RUN-10).
internalContracts.exposedBy: RWB-E1-043 (Build Sequence order 8) through POST /admin/reference-loads, /{loadId}/approve and /{loadId}/rollback, with capability checks C, A and U
internalContracts.flagOffContract: With rwb.p3.configservice off the bean is absent; RWB-E1-043 obtains it through ObjectProvider and refuses PARAMETER with 404 MSG-P4-003 (E43S SPEC-018, SPEC-026, TC-PB-01, TC-FL-01). RWB-E1-043 owns that refusal (D-RUN-10, D-RUN-11, D-RUN-20).

internalContracts.replacementOwner: the story that reads v_ace_batch_status (RWB-E1-069 views; a P3 to P1 read under D-RUN-18)

methods: void recorded(String decisionCode, String table, UUID loadId, List<String> keys, LocalDate validFrom, UUID approverUserId)
internalContracts.contract: Called once per approval, inside the approval transaction before commit; @Transactional(propagation = MANDATORY); throws on failure, which the handler maps to 503 MSG-P7-003. The interim implementation logs one structured line with no user ID. A later implementation in casewf.config calls P7's published DecisionLogWriter and completes its write inside recorded(...) (flush).

internalContracts.visibility: published (casewf.config.api) for listeners in other modules later; today consumed inside casewf.config
internalContracts.contract: Published as a Spring application event after the approval commits; the instance's cache rebuilds on @TransactionalEventListener(AFTER_COMMIT). No approver ID and no personal data. Outbox publication is RWB-TE-006's.

problemMapping.condition: no token or no RW- role on GET
unknown loadId on approve or rollback
no earlier version to roll back to
content conflict, approval after validFrom, rollback of a non-approved load

Replaces InterimCapabilityCheck and keeps the bean name capabilityCheck; reads parameters through access.api.CatalogParameterReader, never casewf.config.api.
